verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an API management and automation platform like Kong/Konnect, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no scheduler. Event Hooks are triggered by entity create, delete or modify events rather than a recurring schedule. The audit-log pull is an on-demand retrieval. decK, kongctl and Terraform are configuration tools a user would have to run from an external scheduler, which is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
